name: spellkave_apply_manifest_delta
label: Apply Manifest Delta
description: Commit/flush authored rows to the ACTIVE connection-level target (#1968 'connection-level target' decision): default (no params) reads the workspace scratch and flushes it — the transaction end after write verbs (author_place/spawn/define_*). Optional `toml` is an escape hatch for an external delta string. `live` dispatches through r_apply_manifest_delta (upsert semantics, ADR-0085); `local` renders/merges into the target folder's manifest.toml. Falls back to the legacy `context.applyDelta` live port when no `target` is wired (back-compat). Requires EITHER to be wired — throws if neither is (offline authoring with no target has no flush destination). A live apply waits for a subscribed outcome: a new digest seal (ok) or a manifest_apply_outcome row (MF-APPLY code). A mid-segment commit error rolls the world back but may publish no failure row; the waiter then hits the scheduler watchdog, not a short poll.

toml.description: Optional escape hatch: a full manifest-delta TOML string to flush. Omit to commit the active workspace scratch (workspace.readToml) — the normal transaction end after write verbs. Pass only when applying an external/ad-hoc delta that is not the scratch pad.

promptSnippet: Commit the workspace scratch (or an optional toml escape hatch) to the active live/local authoring target
promptGuidelines: After write verbs have built the scratch you want live, call spellkave_apply_manifest_delta with NO args to commit that scratch — do not re-read or paste the TOML.
spellkave_apply_manifest_delta: pass `toml` only for an external/ad-hoc delta that is not the workspace scratch.
spellkave_apply_manifest_delta: requires an active connection-level target or legacy applyDelta port.
spellkave_apply_manifest_delta: live apply blocks until a digest seal or a failure outcome is pushed; ok means sealed, not merely enqueued.
spellkave_apply_manifest_delta: a mid-write drain crash rolls the world back (one transaction) but may not push a failure row — a long watchdog then means no outcome, not still applying.

limitations: Scoped prospective-write preflight; binding-only D-6 lane remains separate.
argumentGates: Binding-only payloads retain D-6 server admission; mixed writes require readable prospective state.
Role widening still checks all-contained capabilities or frontier.escalate on the server; unsupported comparison kinds refuse.
